title: So many uses!
text: So many uses!. These are awesome! Husband and I use them in our bedroom when we decide to eat dinner in there, watching TV on our super comfy Tempur-Pedic bed, foot warmer on haha. I'm currently using one to write this review with my laptop on top. Nieces and nephew use them while working on art projects. You name it, they are great. No issues thus far and use them often.
